title: Parsons and Hubbard's Babylon Working
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Parsons and Hubbard's Babylon Working, about 1946 at Pasadena, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The most infamous of these was the Babylon Working, an attempt to summon the divine feminine archetype known as Babylon.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of the Babylon Working, a magic ritual that Jack Parsons, a Pasadena rocket scientist, and L. Ron Hubbard, the man who later founded Scientology, are said to have performed in Pasadena in 1946. According to Michels, they were trying to summon a divine feminine figure called Babylon, following ideas from Aleister Crowley, an English occultist, and his novel Moonchild. He tells it because it would tie the birth of American rocketry to the occult.
